sources.title: John Tate, Residues of differentials on curves, Annales scientifiques de l'E.N.S. (4) 1 (1968), pp. 149-159
sources.locator: Sections 1-3, journal pp. 149-156 (properties (T1)-(T5), Propositions 1-2, Theorem 1, properties (R2)-(R6), Theorems 2-3 and the corollary)

read_evidence.method: The complete Numdam PDF (1,001,892 bytes) was downloaded and extracted to text; Sections 1-3 were read against the batch-8 inventory: the trace properties (T1)-(T5), Propositions 1-2, the definition of the abstract residue in Theorem 1, the numbered properties (R2)-(R6), and Theorems 2-3 with the adelic proof of the residue theorem. The paper's numbering was checked against the items that cite (R4), (R5) and (R6). The scanned printed p. 152 was checked directly for the exact continuity criterion: fA+fgA+fg^2A is contained in A; this full condition is retained in the corrected item, while fA and gA contained in A is a valid special case. The trace identity is recorded with domains made explicit, and the projection formula uses the quotient gA/(A intersected with gA).
read_evidence.scope: Sections 1-3: traces of finite potent endomorphisms, the abstract residue on Omega^1_{K/k}, its properties (R2)-(R6), and the residue theorems on a complete curve including the finiteness argument for H^1(O_X)

contents.name: Properties (T1)-(T3): existence and uniqueness of the trace of a finite potent endomorphism
Properties (T4)-(T5): k-linearity on a finite-potent subspace and, for phi:V'->V and psi:V->V', the domain-correct equality Tr_V(phi psi)=Tr_{V'}(psi phi)
Proposition 1 (E is a k-subalgebra of End_k(V); E_1 and E_2 are two-sided ideals with E_1 + E_2 = E, E_1 n E_2 = E_0 finite potent)
Proposition 2 (a commutator with gamma in E_0 and psi in E, or gamma in E_1 and psi in E_2, lies in E_0 and has zero trace)
Theorem 1 (existence and uniqueness of the abstract residue res_V on Omega^1_{K/k}, res_V(f dg) = Tr_V([f_1, g_1]) for suitable lifts)

Properties (R2)-(R4): R2 uses the full condition fA+fgA+fg^2A subset A; R4 is res_A(h g^{-1} dg)=Tr_{A/N}(m_h)-Tr_{gA/N}(m_h) for N=A intersected with gA and hA subset A, with the unit/divisibility special case
Property (R5) (additivity: res_{A+B} + res_{A n B} = res_A + res_B for two stable subspaces)
Property (R6) (a finite free extension K' of K and the trace of multiplication on K')
Section 3, the definition of res_p on the completion and Theorem 2 (res_p(f dg) is the coefficient of t^{-1} in f(t) g'(t) at a k-rational point)
Section 3, the adelic spaces V_X and A_X, the diagonal image of K, and the presentation V_X/(K + A_X) = H^1(X, O_X) used in the proof of Theorem 3
Theorem 3 and its Corollary (for a complete curve, sum over all closed points of res_p(omega) = 0)
Theorem 4 (trace formula for a surjective morphism of curves) and Theorem 5 (c: Omega^1 -> J is an isomorphism for X/k smooth)
contents.reason: The trace-transformation and Cartier-operator theorems serve the later ramification and duality machinery of the source; this page proves the ramification formula from the batch-6 canonical-bundle ramification theorem instead.
